description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role
We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer (Identity & Access Systems) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (San Jose, CA – 3 days/week in office) role, reporting to the Senior Director, Security Compliance in the Exposure Management & Security Operations / Technology Risk & Compliance department. We are seeking an experienced Staff Security Engineer to architect, scale, and govern our workload trust and access systems across our cloud-native Zero Trust ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the technical strategy for non-human identity (NHI) lifecycle management, establish real-time telemetry and observability pipelines, and automate service-to-service access controls to ensure robust enterprise security with developer-friendly velocity.
What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
Architect and scale secure authentication and authorization mechanisms for distributed services, microservices, API clients, and cloud workloads across our Zero Trust ecosystem
Establish and operate end-to-end Non-Human Identity (NHI) governance workflows—including automated onboarding, secret rotation, dependency tracking, and decommissioning for Server-to-Server (S2S) clients
Design and maintain real-time observability pipelines, telemetry dashboards (e.g., Grafana), and alerting strategies to monitor authentication health, rate limits, and access anomalies
Drive infrastructure automation and secret orchestration by integrating modern standards (OAuth 2.0, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE) into CI/CD pipelines and developer self-service tooling
Provide cross-functional technical leadership, collaborating closely with platform infrastructure, IT, and software engineering teams to embed security guardrails without impeding deployment velocity
Who You Are (Success Profile)
You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing a dynamic, evolving environment as an opportunity to design and build meaningful solutions.
You operate with an owner's mindset and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to deliver high-integrity outcomes.
You think at scale, connecting day-to-day security engineering to the broader organizational mission and building robust, long-term processes built to support high-growth global platforms.
You champion simplicity by distilling complex technical security challenges and organizational needs into exceptionally clear, actionable plans and focused communications.
You are a high-trust collaborator who actively participates in a challenge-oriented culture, sharing and receiving respectful feedback to build trust and elevate team performance.
What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)
Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
8+ years of relevant engineering experience across Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Distributed Systems, Infrastructure/SRE, or Identity & Access Management (IAM)
Deep functional and technical understanding of authentication (AuthN) vs. authorization (AuthZ) mechanisms, token lifecycle handling (OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, OIDC, JWT), and access control models (RBAC/ABAC)
Hands-on experience governing machine, workload, or service-to-service (S2S) identity lifecycles and credentials in modern cloud environments
Practical experience designing operational metrics, log aggregation, and real-time observability dashboards (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog)
Strong track record of driving cross-functional alignment across security, IT, and platform engineering teams with clear technical communication
What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
Practical familiarity with workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) and mTLS/Private PKI certificate lifecycles
Hands-on experience with enterprise secrets orchestration platforms (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)
Proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash for automating identity workflows and interacting with REST APIs
